title: PERF-M2-T02b: typed BenchmarkRecord (schema 1.0), compare(), nearest-rank percentiles, detected hardware class
summary: Added src/perf/benchmark_record.py (frozen BenchmarkRecord with R-1..R-5, identity collector, compare() with the OD-3 excursion split), BenchHarness emits last_record with nearest-rank percentiles, PERF_* take the detected hardware class; schema doc is now the schema-1.0 contract (DEV-020, INFRA-430). No gate behaviour change.

title: PERF-M2-T07: canonical variants of the PERF_* profiles
summary: Added canonical_variant() and PERF_CANONICAL_PROFILES (name suffix _CANONICAL, signal_contract CANONICAL) in src/perf/profiles.py for the 8 PERF_* profiles; defaults, PERF_MATRIX and the LIVE default unchanged.
